contract.object: Generator A:D(A)⊂H→H of a bounded strongly continuous linear semigroup T(t) on a complex Hilbert space H.
contract.type_domain: Complex Hilbert space; bounded linear C0-semigroup; iR⊂rho(A), so 0∈rho(A) and A^{-1} is bounded; alpha>0.
contract.conditions: High-frequency resolvent growth is compared with regularized orbit decay under the Borichev–Tomilov Theorem 2.4 contract; the source asymptotic is recorded as s→+∞.
contract.quantity: The norms ||R(is,A)||, ||T(t)(-A)^(-alpha)|| and ||T(t)A^(-1)||, including operator-norm O-rates and pointwise little-o rates.
contract.claim: Polynomial growth ||R(is,A)||=O(|s|^alpha) is equivalent to ||T(t)(-A)^(-alpha)||=O(t^-1) and ||T(t)A^(-1)||=O(t^(-1/alpha)), with the corresponding pointwise little-o formulations.
contract.limits: No claim about polynomial decay of raw ||T(t)||, no removal of bounded-semigroup or iR⊂rho(A) hypotheses, no arbitrary Banach-space export, no transient-peak reconstruction, no CORE5 extension.

sources.locator: Borichev–Tomilov, Math. Ann. 347 (2010), Theorem 2.4 and its proof; polynomial resolvent growth versus regularized orbit decay on Hilbert space.
